subject: [PATCH v5 16/22] gfs2: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations for the GFS2 file system to use the new ->iomap_next() callback, which is generated by a macro that wraps the iomap_iter_next helper and ensures proper cleanup of previous mappings. The conversion does not introduce any functional changes. The patch updates the gfs2_iomap_ops structure to point to the newly defined gfs2_iomap_next function.
